vintage: INSEE recensement de Mayotte 2017, detailed commune tables published 2019-08-05
methodology: Commune-level counts from the 2017 Mayotte census are distributed over commune polygons and summed within each hex. Values cover only Mayotte; the rest of France is null because these are territory-specific census tables. Higher education is measured among non-scolarized residents aged 15 or older.
